title: SAP Concur Expense Entry
description: Schema for an SAP Concur Expense Entry — a single expense line item within an expense report representing a specific transaction such as a meal, hotel, flight, or other business expense.

ID.description: The unique identifier of the expense entry

ReportID.description: The parent expense report ID that contains this entry

ExpenseTypeCode.description: Expense category code (e.g., BUSML for Business Meal, AIRFR for Airfare, HOTEL for Hotel)

TransactionDate.description: ISO 8601 date when the expense transaction occurred

TransactionAmount.description: Expense amount in the original transaction currency

TransactionCurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction

PostedAmount.description: Expense amount converted and posted in the report currency

ExchangeRate.description: Exchange rate used to convert transaction currency to report currency

BusinessPurpose.description: Description of the business reason for this expense

VendorDescription.description: Name of the vendor, merchant, or service provider

LocationName.description: City or location where the expense was incurred

IsItemized.description: Whether this entry has been broken down into itemized sub-entries

HasVAT.description: Whether VAT/GST tax applies to this entry

ReceiptImageID.description: ID of the receipt image attached to this entry

ReceiptReceived.description: Whether a receipt has been received and attached

ReceiptRequired.description: Whether a receipt is required by expense policy for this entry

Comment.description: Additional notes or comments from the expense owner

URI.description: Full URI for the expense entry resource
